items.note: S1.3.1 states the lemma's conclusion: three stages of copy/gather/scatter/side-injection send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) for arbitrary scratch values and restore every auxiliary value. It omits the per-invocation y_S+x_S and the cancellation (JV+RG)x=identity, so it is not derived.

S1.3.2 gives a frame common to all incidences of a gate and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, quoting the commutation line 812. The edge operator D_vD_u^{-1} and the route form eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1} are only implied.

Comparable nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, the only decreasing edges central with loss h, and the total Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2 are all correct. The label construction (triple indicators, orthogonal for neighbours), L=Ich and the exact ratios 100/539, 101/539 are missing.

It has the endpoint I_m on every role and s_b<W_b m, and S1.4.3.1 gives the shear H<-H+D on every row. The negative source projections -P_{U_a} and the rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are missing, and P_U is called the frame when the frame is Phi_{P_U}.

One kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c<W_c m are correct. The frame C_U is not defined and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c is not given. The claim says the endpoints telescope to C^{⊗m}, which in the paper holds only after the diagonal Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} corrections and undoing the signed exchange (lines 1297-1314).

S1.3 reaches s<Wm and S1.3.6 gets s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}, which is the paper's route. Two links are missing: the conversion from dimension budget to rank (rank = dimension change plus N rank-one source edges, giving Wm-N+2L, which is why L<N/2 is needed) and log m<20. The exact eta values are also absent.
Both lemmas are stated in substance. S1.2 drops the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, though its own quote contains it, and drops the prime modulus and unit conditions.

Both the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V) are stated correctly, and S1.4.1 feeds S1.4.2. The elimination proof and the D+=H, swap, D=H-D realization of each one in Pi are not shown.

The paper's route is all there: cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, edge shears by recursive interchanges, gates pointwise, the shear H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau), and the parking-stack depth-first schedule at O(V) per node.
It gives rows from a few high digits, padding, base-m splitting of the width and the O(Vu^tau) bound, with no sub-steps.

s_c child calls of C^{⊗f} on e=mf bits, exact Gaussian dyadic wrappers and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D are correct. The conjugation by P_M, which reduces kernels to coordinate slots, and the inverse-child identity are not shown. Binary basis changes appear only in the S1.5 method.

It states the XOR with the scratch chunk restored and the parameter-family bound O(V(L^tau+1)). The method names eight controlled cyclic rotations and a sorting repair, but no sub-step follows the derivation, and delta_bad is not given.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with rows split among roles is quoted correctly. The leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the base-m partition and the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda' are missing.

Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) and one final truncation are correct. The sub-steps follow the paper's route: H_0 through C, phase-frame recursion, packed basis changes, the recurrence, guard widths, then truncation. The arithmetic-depth recurrence behind Delta is not shown.

Character cancellation, F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, DIF into bit-reversed B_t and the cost formula are correct, and the route matches. The error bound sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, the layout permutation L in the counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the per-round cost accounting are absent.
It states an exact product by signed Kronecker packing, returning Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)). The evaluation point B_0=2^{4p} and the centered residues are not given.

It follows the paper's route: two forward transforms in a common stored order, packed pointwise products, the permutation commuting with the pointwise product, the opposite transform, and error addition to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}. The final exact scale by M is left implicit.

The 1-D identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA from the HvdH identity, tensoring to RF_s=2^gamma B_0 QF_t A, and the exposure cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) are correct. The hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 and the approximation costs are omitted. How A and B_0 are built from N=CTD and N^{-1} is not shown.
Both identities are stated correctly, and S2.6.5 gives RF_s^+ by conjugation. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined.
The fixed rationals tau, lambda', epsilon, c, kappa are given correctly. The sizes b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, the prime source lengths s_i and the window (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i are absent.
It states an isomorphism x->prod x_i^{mu_i} preserving convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the triangular digit formula and the cost are not given.
The twist turning cyclic into negacyclic convolution, with the wrap recovered, is correct. zeta=e^{pi i/r} and the interface M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T are missing.

The source transform as a composition with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate procedure, and the six-step outline are present. S2.6.6 calls the two scalings 'by S' when the second is by 2^{2b+4}S, and the digit scaling by 2^{-b-2} is absent.
Only the conclusion is given: error below 1/2, so rounding, Phi^{-1} and carries are exact. The error chain E_s, E_w and 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}, and the role of gamma<=b/4, are missing.
The minimum margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, the schoolbook cutoff and the final bound are correct. The normalized cost list, V=Tp=Theta(n) and the absorption of log factors are not given.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n conjecture in the model, but gives no liminf or eventual-lower-bound formulation.

errors.says: the endpoints telescope to C^{⊗m} on every role
errors.paper: telescoping gives C^{⊗m} only after the source and sink diagonal corrections (Z_{a,k}, scalar i^{27k}) and undoing the signed bank exchange; the raw X_a->Y_a route carries C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates

errors.says: with projection matrices P_U as frames, the bit network routes every role through the endpoint shear I_m
errors.paper: the matrices are M_v=P_U at gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources; the frames are the address shears Phi_{M_v}, and the endpoint difference M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m

errors.says: an update y->y+a(controls) mod Q ... costs O(V)
errors.paper: O(V) only if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the controls, with a prime q and coefficients whose denominators are prime to q

errors.says: each edge costs as many half-size calls as its rank
errors.paper: each recursive call is on chunks of width e/m and a role stream of volume V/W, not half size

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: two fixed networks with a rank deficit, the fast interchange and the simultaneous butterfly layer, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with the chirp, CRT and twist, assembly and the time table. The central saving thins at one point. S1.3.3 gives the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L, but no step converts dimensions into ranks (rank = dimension change, plus N rank-one source edges), so it is unexplained why L<N/2 rather than L<N gives s<Wm. The arithmetic half is mostly asserted: transform error and cost, the exact-recovery error chain and the cost table are claimed without their quantities.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary restored is there. h=100, the triple indexing, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are not, apart from 'm-dimensional F^{⊗3}' and the reliance on triple-intersection.
It gives an invertible frame common to all incidences of a gate, commuting with the pointwise gate, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, so intermediate frames cancel.
It gives comparable nondegenerate labels in the m-dimensional F^{⊗3} and makes the central-wire returns of loss h the only decreasing edges. The step 3->4 timing is in its quote only.
S1.3's motivation says edge cost is counted by label dimension change. There is no rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U argument, and the N rank-one source edges are missing.
Wm-2N+2L is stated. L=Ich and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are absent, so the budget is never turned into the rank sum.

L<N/2 and s<Wm are both stated. The ratios 100/539 and 101/539 and the deficit N-2L>0 are missing, and without the extra N source ranks the role of the N/2 threshold is unexplained. Marked mentioned to be conservative.
S1.3.4 gives the endpoint I_m on every role, and S1.4.3.1 gives the shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included. The -P_{U_a} source matrices are not named.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the motivation 'an edge matrix of rank a costs a smaller interchanges' together give s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all there. Only the link log m<20 is omitted.

central.summary: The plan has the frame identity, the labels, the endpoint shear, the rank-a cost of an edge and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. It does not reconstruct how the dimension budget becomes the rank sum: rank equals dimension change plus N rank-one source edges, so s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and the deficit is N-2L. The strict saving s<Wm is therefore asserted rather than explained, and the fixed network's parameters (h=100, N, m) are not given.
